# OpenPGP message setup now follows the real aboutMessage document lifecycle

1270 removes custom load-enigmail/unload-enigmail event listeners and merges message cleanup into messageFrameUnload. Accepted aboutMessage calls messengerStartup and hdrViewLoad directly in its DOMContentLoaded path, which rejects events from other target documents. messengerStartup still listens to the message pane unload. A scoped lifecycle recommendation is to trace the actual owner document and message frame before adding new setup/cleanup hooks. This does not prove every timer or listener is cleaned up at window destruction. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mail/extensions/openpgp.
